hero.title: Technology Solutions for Every Industry
hero.subtitle: From FinTech to HealthTech, E-Commerce to EdTech — we build powerful digital products tailored to the unique challenges of your industry.

intro.label: ✦ Our Expertise
intro.heading: 12+ Industries. 150+ Projects. One Trusted Partner.
intro.description: Every industry has its own rules, regulations, and user expectations. We go deep into your domain before writing a single line of code — so what we build fits your business perfectly, not just technically.

industries.title: FinTech & Banking
industries.shortDesc: Secure, scalable financial platforms built for compliance and speed.
industries.description: We build RBI-compliant banking apps, payment gateways, lending platforms, and wealth management tools with bank-grade security and real-time transaction processing.
industries.challenge: Strict compliance requirements, real-time transaction demands, and zero-tolerance for security vulnerabilities.

industries.title: HealthTech & MedTech
industries.shortDesc: HIPAA-ready digital health solutions improving patient outcomes.
industries.description: From patient management systems and telemedicine platforms to AI diagnostics and hospital ERP solutions — we digitize healthcare workflows that save lives.
industries.challenge: HIPAA/DPDP compliance, real-time data accuracy, and seamless integration with legacy hospital systems.

industries.title: E-Commerce & Retail
industries.shortDesc: High-converting online stores built for scale and retention.
industries.description: We build blazing-fast e-commerce platforms, marketplace apps, and retail management systems that convert visitors into loyal customers and scale to millions of transactions.
industries.challenge: High traffic spikes, cart abandonment, complex inventory, and personalizing experiences for millions of users.

industries.title: EdTech & E-Learning
industries.shortDesc: Engaging learning platforms that drive completion and retention.
industries.description: We build LMS platforms, gamified learning apps, live tutoring systems, and AI-powered personalized learning experiences that keep students engaged.
industries.challenge: Low engagement, high drop-off rates, and delivering consistent experiences across low-bandwidth regions.

industries.title: Real Estate & PropTech
industries.shortDesc: Smart property platforms that close deals faster.
industries.description: From AI-powered property discovery and virtual tours to CRM systems and mortgage calculators — we digitize the entire real estate journey for buyers, sellers, and agents.
industries.challenge: Slow search, lack of personalization, and fragmented data across hundreds of thousands of listings.

industries.title: Logistics & Supply Chain
industries.shortDesc: ML-driven logistics systems that cut costs and delays.
industries.description: We build route optimization engines, fleet management platforms, warehouse automation tools, and real-time supply chain visibility dashboards that reduce operational costs.
industries.challenge: Manual routing costing millions, blind spots in supply chain, and no real-time visibility for fleet managers.

industries.title: Manufacturing & Industry 4.0
industries.shortDesc: IoT and automation solutions for the modern factory floor.
industries.description: We connect machines, workers, and data through IoT platforms, predictive maintenance systems, and manufacturing ERP solutions that reduce downtime and increase output.
industries.challenge: Unplanned machine downtime, manual quality checks, and zero real-time visibility across production lines.

industries.title: Food & Restaurant Tech
industries.shortDesc: End-to-end digital solutions for restaurants and food businesses.
industries.description: From online ordering and table management to kitchen display systems and food delivery aggregator integrations — we build the full digital stack for food businesses.
industries.challenge: Fragmented order channels, manual kitchen workflows, and lack of customer retention tools.

steps.title: Domain Discovery
steps.description: We spend the first 2 weeks learning your industry — regulations, competitors, user behavior, and pain points specific to your domain.

steps.title: Solution Architecture
steps.description: We design a solution architecture tailored to your industry's scale, security, and integration requirements.

steps.title: Agile Development
steps.description: Development happens in 2-week sprints with constant client demos — ensuring what we build always matches your vision.

steps.title: Compliance & Testing
steps.description: Industry-specific testing: HIPAA audits for HealthTech, PCI-DSS for FinTech, load testing for E-Commerce.

steps.title: Launch & Scale
steps.description: Smooth go-live with hypercare support, followed by data-driven optimization as your business grows.

faqs.question: Do you specialize in one industry or work across multiple?
faqs.answer: We work across 12+ industries but maintain dedicated domain teams for FinTech, HealthTech, E-Commerce, and EdTech — our four core verticals where we have the deepest expertise.

faqs.question: How do you handle industry-specific compliance requirements?
faqs.answer: We have compliance specialists for each major vertical. For FinTech we cover RBI/PCI-DSS, for HealthTech we cover HIPAA/DPDP, and for E-Commerce we handle PCI compliance and data privacy regulations.

faqs.question: Can you build solutions for niche industries not listed here?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our discovery process is designed to quickly understand any domain. We've built solutions for agriculture tech, legal tech, and government platforms. Contact us to discuss your specific industry.

faqs.question: Do you have existing industry-specific templates or do you build from scratch?
faqs.answer: We use proven architecture patterns and component libraries for common industry needs — saving time without sacrificing customization. Every product is tailored, never copy-pasted.

faqs.question: What is the typical project cost for an industry-specific platform?
faqs.answer: Costs vary by scope and industry. A mobile banking app starts at ₹25L, an e-commerce platform at ₹15L, and an enterprise ERP at ₹50L+. We provide detailed quotes after a free discovery call.
